text: Mina: quick design thread exploring an alternative to the modal-badge pattern for bulk invites. idea: a thin SSO ribbon inside the invite drawer (under the title) that states org policy and links to settings. also want a clear post-invite path to audit results. sketches attached. Jae: interesting. ribbon could be lower visual weight than a header chip but more prominent than a tiny badge. where exactly in the DOM are you imagining it? Mina: inside the drawer, immediately below the title and above the bulk upload area. visible but not in the title line. it should be read-only and signal that SSO is an org policy (no per-invite change). Rowan: a11y concern: anything visually emphasized still needs to be keyboard reachable and announced. if it's a link to settings, ensure tabindex is present and aria-label matches visible text. Also provide a hidden explanatory element referenced by aria-describedby: "Single sign-on is required for this organization; changes must be made in Organization settings." Felix: implementation-wise the ribbon can be an anchor with role="region" and role="link" inside. sample markup: ``` SSO required 12 managed in Organization settings ``` on navigate, settings reads ?panel=sso and focuses the SSO heading. avoid any stateful toggles inside the drawer. Jae: copy debate security insists on the verb "required". product worried "required" reads too strict for new admins. compromise: ribbon visible text "SSO required" and a secondary line in the ribbon: "managed in Organization settings". tooltip could soften language. Rowan: tooltip strategy: don't rely solely on hover. provide a small info button inside the ribbon that opens an accessible dialog or popover. ensure the popover content is in DOM and dismissible with Escape. add aria-describedby from the ribbon to that popover content. Also check color contrast for both lines of text in the ribbon 12 aim for 4.5:1. Felix: engineering note: the ribbon should be a semantic landmark so screen reader users can find it quickly. role="region" with an aria-label like "Authentication policy" would help. Also add a skip link at the top of the drawer: "Skip to invite activity" which jumps to the footer audit link. Mina: audit path: after successful bulk upload, the drawer confirmation will show a CTA "Open invite activity" which links to /orgs/:id/audit?filter=invites&batch=TIMESTAMP. SRE wants the audit events to include a field sso_status:required so parsers can pick it up. Jae: visual note ribbon height 40px, subtle left border accent color, two-line layout on narrow viewports with the secondary line using 13px. avoid crowding the title area. Rowan: keyboard flow to validate: 1) Tab into drawer header, 2) Tab to ribbon link, 3) Tab to ribbon info button and open popover with Space/Enter, 4) Popover read by screen reader, 5) Tab continues to form fields, 6) Footer audit link reachable before close. Also test with NVDA and VoiceOver. Felix: i'll prototype HTML/CSS for the ribbon + accessible popover and a tiny script to deep-link to settings and to focus the audit result when returning from /audit?from=invite-drawer. avoid animated focus transitions when navigating directly for SR compatibility. Mina: microcopy finalization: product likes this pair: visible first line = "SSO required"; second line = "Managed in Organization settings"; popover text: "Single sign-on is required for this organization. To change this policy, visit Organization settings." Security happy? Jae: security asked we keep the audit field exact: sso_status: required (no punctuation). we'll reflect that in the event payload. Rowan: confirm aria-label should mirror the visible text: yes. also recommend adding role="status" to the ribbon for polite announcements when the drawer opens so SR users hear the policy without extra navigation. but be careful: role="status" will announce on load; test for noise. Felix: good call. i'll implement role="region" with aria-live="polite" on open for a single announcement then remove aria-live to avoid repeated announcements. or use aria-atomic. will prototype and we can test with screen reader. Mina: success path UX: after upload finishes, show a compact confirmation card with counts and a link: "Open invite activity" (deep link with batch id). Confirmation should reiterate SSO status for clarity: e.g., "Invites sent. SSO required applies to invited accounts." Jae: small accessibility/visual nit the ribbon's accent color needs to pass contrast for icons too. and the info button should have at least 44x44 tap target on touch devices. Rowan: add to test plan: keyboard-only run, NVDA/VoiceOver walkthrough, check screen reader behavior with and without aria-live, and mobile screen reader (TalkBack) spot check. Felix: i'll include a Cypress keyboard test and a short manual SR checklist. will avoid CSS-only tooltips; popover DOM needs to be inserted/removed programmatically. CI-Runner: build queued for branch feat/invite-sso-ribbon at 2156789400 10 https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/8888 Mina: thanks team. next steps: Felix pushes prototype -> internal a11y QA -> 2-admin moderated usability focusing on discoverability of SSO policy and accessing audit entries. keep copy as "SSO required" + secondary line "Managed in Organization settings." follow up with any changes after staging validation. :wave:
